transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I just don’t have much push anymore. I used to go to choir, do my quilting, visit folks, but lately I mostly just sit at home with the TV on low. Even when I know people are expecting me, I just… don’t get going.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, more days than not?
I don’t know that I’d call it depressed. I’m just… kind of flat, I guess. Not really sure.
Have you noticed that you don’t take much pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like choir or quilting?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to get something out of choir and quilting, seeing folks too. Now I mostly just stay home with the TV low. Even when I know they’re expecting me, I just don’t seem to get myself going.
Do you feel down or sad most of the time, even when you're at home with the TV on?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t really say sad most of the time. It’s more like I’m just there, not feeling much one way or the other.
Do you find yourself feeling down or in a depressed mood most of the time, even when you're just sitting at home?
Not really depressed, no… I mean, I sit there and I’m just kind of blank. I don’t think I’d call it down most of the time.
Would you say that most of the time, you feel down or in a low mood, even when you're just sitting at home?
I don’t think so… not low most of the time. It’s more just sitting there, kind of nothing.
Would you say that, even for part of the day, you feel down or in a low mood, even if it's not most of the time?
Maybe a little sometimes… but I don’t really keep track of it. It’s not something I think about much.
Would you say that you feel down or in a low mood for a good part of the day, even if it’s not most of the time?
I’m not sure… maybe here and there, but I wouldn’t say a good part of the day. I don’t really notice it like that.
Would you say that you take less pleasure in most activities, like choir or quilting, compared to before?
Yes… I guess so. I don’t have the push for choir or quilting like I used to. Mostly I just stay home with the TV on low, even when I know folks are expecting me.
Would you say that you feel down or in a low mood for a significant part of the day, even if it comes and goes?
I don’t know… significant sounds like a lot. I might feel low now and then, but I don’t really notice it taking up much of the day.
Would you say that you feel down or in a low mood for a significant part of the day, even if it comes and goes?
I think I already said… I don’t really know. It comes and goes maybe, but I don’t keep track of it like that.
Would you say that you feel down or in a low mood for a significant part of the day, even if it comes and goes?
I’m not sure what else to say… I don’t notice it that much during the day. Maybe here and there, but I couldn’t say it’s a big part of the day.
Would you say that you feel down or in a low mood for a significant part of the day, even if it comes and goes?
I guess… no, not really. I don’t think it takes up a big part of my day. I just don’t pay much attention to it.
Would you say that you take less pleasure in most activities, like choir or quilting, compared to before?
Yes… I guess I do. I don’t have the push for choir or quilting like I used to. Mostly I just stay home with the TV on low, even when I know folks are expecting me.
Would you say that you take less pleasure in most activities than you used to, not just choir or quilting?
Yes… most things, I guess. I just don’t feel much like going out or seeing folks. I end up sitting at home with the TV on low.
Would you say that you feel down or in a low mood for a significant part of the day, even if it comes and goes?
I don’t know… not really all day or anything. I haven’t been keeping track of it.
Would you say that most days, for most of the day, you feel down or in a low mood, even if it's not severe?
I’m not sure… I don’t think it’s most of the day, most days. It’s just kind of hard to say.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or in a low mood for most of the day, even if it's not very severe?
I don’t really know… I don’t think I’d say most of the day. I just have times where I feel low, but I haven’t paid that close attention.
Would you say that you’ve completely stopped enjoying things like choir, quilting, or seeing people, or do you still get some enjoyment out of them, even if not as much as before?

I still get a little something out of them, I guess. I haven’t completely stopped. It’s more… I just don’t have the push to go to choir or do my quilting, or go see folks. Most days I end up sitting at home with the TV on low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Would you say that you feel a lack of energy or fatigue nearly every day, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I don’t know… I get tired sometimes, but I haven’t really kept track if it’s nearly every day. I’m not doing much, so it’s hard to say.
